sample_unit: gastroscopic images (three datasets: LGLDD, Endo21, HyperKvasir)

links.outcome: Hallucination rate of diagnostic descriptions with retrieval-augmented, concept-grounded generation versus MLLM baselines
links.effect: Hallucination rate 7.8% versus 15-20% for baseline MLLMs; AP 40.9% versus 39.5% for best baseline.
links.quote: On LGLDD, Endo21, and HyperKvasir, TrustEndo achieves AP 40.9% (vs. 39.5% best MLLM baseline), hallucination rate 7.8% (vs. 15-20%), and ECE 0.038 (vs. 0.118+), with 95% empirical coverage on detection.
